ui.hero.title: One platform for all the animals under your care
ui.hero.sub: Records, daily operations and teamwork across all your units. Find any task in Antz, with the real screens.
ui.modules.lede: Touch any card to open the corresponding guide, with all the features and their screens.
ui.cta.text: Each module has its features and real screens in this guide. Continue from where you stopped or talk to us and we will help.
ui.day.title: What your first day in Antz is like
ui.day.2: Get your bearings on the platform
ui.day.4: Give each person the right access
ui.day.4.desc: Create profiles that correspond to your organisation and activate the permissions module by module, so that each person sees what their work requires.
ui.faq.q2: Does it work on mobile phones and computers?
ui.faq.a2: Yes. The mobile application covers the work in the field, such as notes, treatments, transfers and egg records. The web application covers the office work, such as the hospital system, the nursery setup, the reports and the pharmacy stock. Updates appear in real time on the mobile phone, on the tablet and on the computer.
ui.faq.q3: Can we control who sees what?
ui.faq.a3: Yes. Access is based on profiles. You create the profiles your organisation uses, for example Zoologist, and activate the permissions module by module.
ui.faq.q4: We have more than one unit. Does this work?
ui.faq.a4: Antz keeps the data of all units and departments in one place. The housing is organised by unit, sector and enclosure, and the movements between units go through approval and through a release of exit by security.
ui.faq.a5: Start with the Getting started guide and then open the modules that your profile uses. If something is not clear, write to hello@antz.systems.

m.necropsy.title: Necropsy
m.necropsy.intro: The Necropsy Module documents post-mortem examinations with detailed observations, findings by organ and medical conclusions. It supports the precise analysis of the cause of death, standardises the reports, ensures the timely handling of carcasses and meets legal, audit and veterinary standards.
m.necropsy.f1.title: Search and filters
m.necropsy.f1.desc: Search by animal/species; filter by unit, date and priority.
m.necropsy.f2.title: Status tracking
m.necropsy.f2.desc: Follow the stages: To receive, Pending, Draft and Completed.
m.necropsy.f3.title: Animal card and request data
m.necropsy.f3.desc: AID, species, location, cause, requester, priority.
m.deworming.title: Deworming
m.deworming.intro: The Deworming Module supports the systematic recording and tracking of antiparasitic treatments, ensuring administration on time, adequate documentation and clear follow-up of each deworming of each animal.
m.deworming.f1.title: Views by status
m.deworming.f1.desc: Dewormings organised into Upcoming, Pending, Jumped and Completed, to make tracking easier.
m.deworming.f2.title: Deworming management
m.deworming.f2.desc: Schedule a treatment or record directly the medication administered, with defined dates and details.
m.deworming.f3.title: Administration record
m.deworming.f3.desc: Records dosage, batch number, route of administration, observations and optional follow-up.
m.housing.title: Housing
m.housing.intro: The Housing module organises the animals' habitats into their units, sectors and enclosures, so that each animal has a known place and each change is recorded. Access at each level is based on permissions.
m.housing.f1.title: Unit administration
m.housing.f1.desc: Add or edit units with profile-based permissions, for secure and structured access.
m.housing.f2.title: Sector administration
m.housing.f2.desc: Add or edit sectors within the zoo, with permission-based controls for secure administration.
m.housing.f3.title: Enclosure administration
m.housing.f3.desc: Add or edit enclosures and track each one for efficient oversight of the animals and the data.
m.fetal-death.title: Fetal Death
m.fetal-death.intro: The Fetal Death Module records and manages occurrences of fetal death in the enclosures, recording cause, moment and data of the related animals. It supports veterinary care, the tracking of reproductive health, trend analysis and better population management.
m.fetal-death.f1.title: Add fetal death record
m.fetal-death.f1.desc: Record new occurrences: cause, moment, kinship, animal data.
m.fetal-death.f2.title: Search and filters
m.fetal-death.f2.desc: Search by keyword; filter by unit, date, stillborn or abortion, species or sex.
m.fetal-death.f3.title: View death records
m.fetal-death.f3.desc: Complete details, days since the death, cause, ID, enclosure, unit, sex.
m.egg-management-app.title: Egg Management — App
m.egg-management-app.intro: The Egg Module tracks the whole life cycle of the eggs, from laying to hatching or to transfer to the nursery, ensuring precise records, real-time updates and complete traceability for better coordination and accountability among the nest, nursery and hatchery teams.
m.egg-management-app.f1.title: Egg dashboard
m.egg-management-app.f1.desc: Real-time counts: in the nests, sent to the nursery, marked for disposal.
m.egg-management-app.f2.title: Egg record (nest / nursery)
m.egg-management-app.f2.desc: Add eggs with parents, condition, dates, species, observations and attachments.
m.egg-management-app.f3.title: Life cycle tracking
m.egg-management-app.f3.desc: Status, weight and the complete timeline of the egg's journey.
m.administer-medicine.title: Administer Medication
m.administer-medicine.intro: The Administration Module complements the Medical Records by transforming prescriptions into practical treatment flows, allowing the delivery of real-time care to individual animals or in batch, in the field or in the hospital.
m.administer-medicine.f1.title: Quick record
m.administer-medicine.f1.desc: Create a direct administration record for a chosen date without filling in a complete medical record.
m.administer-medicine.f2.title: Search and filters
m.administer-medicine.f2.desc: Find records quickly and narrow the list by date, entity [?], species and controlled substance.
m.administer-medicine.f3.title: Status tracking
m.administer-medicine.f3.desc: View the treatments by date in four tabs: Pending, Administered, Jumped, Interrupted.
m.vaccination.title: Vaccination
m.vaccination.intro: The Vaccination Module manages the whole vaccination cycle of the animals, from scheduling and direct administration to tracking upcoming, pending, jumped and completed vaccinations. It ensures treatments on time, exact recording of the dosage and complete traceability for disease prevention and clinical compliance.
m.vaccination.f1.title: Views by status
m.vaccination.f1.desc: Vaccinations organised into Upcoming, Pending, Jumped and Completed, to make tracking easier.
m.vaccination.f2.title: Vaccination management
m.vaccination.f2.desc: Schedule a vaccination or record directly a vaccine administered, with dates and medication details defined.
m.vaccination.f3.title: Administration record
m.vaccination.f3.desc: Records dosage, batch number, route of administration, observations and optional follow-up.
m.pharmacy-web.title: Pharmacy (Web)
m.pharmacy-web.intro: Allows the fast, precise and traceable dispensing of medical products directly to authorised doctors, ensuring service on time and automatic updating of the stock, from the prescription to the shelf, with visibility by batch and expiry control at all stages.
m.pharmacy-web.f1.title: Dashboard
m.pharmacy-web.f1.desc: Real-time analyses on stock problems, shipments, purchases, requests, consumption, expiries and high-turnover products, with visual trends to act quickly.
m.pharmacy-web.f2.title: Smart search and filters
m.pharmacy-web.f2.desc: Find records quickly by request ID, doctor's name or pharmacy.
m.pharmacy-web.f3.title: Registers (shelving units and shelves)
m.pharmacy-web.f3.desc: Organise storage by number of shelving units/shelves for quick access and updating, with customisable data (packaging, unit of measure, salts [?], drivers [?], manufacturers).
m.pharmacy-web.f4.title: Stock report management
m.pharmacy-web.f4.desc: Stock by batch with value and expiry; flag items with low stock or expired; track the upcoming expiries; manage items in custody [?] with resolution of discrepancies.
m.pharmacy-web.f5.title: Product and stock management
m.pharmacy-web.f5.desc: Create products, track stock and expiry, record purchases/dispatches, keep a unified ledger and manage substitutes/variants.
m.pharmacy-web.f6.title: Dispensing management
m.pharmacy-web.f6.desc: Doctors can prescribe and dispense, or collect medication directly at the pharmacy, with everything recorded.
m.pharmacy-web.f7.title: Shipment management
m.pharmacy-web.f7.desc: Track the medication shipments that arrive and that leave and write them off [?] through the application.
m.pharmacy-web.f8.title: Stock adjustment and reports
m.pharmacy-web.f8.desc: Record stock changes (missing, damaged, expired); keep the audit history; manage returns to suppliers; download reports on consumption, return, purchase and dispensing for finance and demand forecasting.
m.getting-started.title: Getting started
m.getting-started.intro: The Getting started guide presents the purpose of the application and leads new users through the essential steps to set up the profile, explore the main features and navigate the platform efficiently.
m.getting-started.f1.title: Access and workspaces
m.getting-started.f1.desc: Log in securely and access your designated work environment.
m.getting-started.f2.title: Navigation and interface
m.getting-started.f2.desc: Use the home screen feed to see updates and quick navigation shortcuts, and the bottom panel for the main tools.
m.getting-started.f3.title: Pending Necropsy / Administration / Allocation
m.getting-started.f3.desc: Animals awaiting necropsy, administrative documentation and the following allocation or disposal procedures before the definitive closing of the records.
m.getting-started.f4.title: Master setup and modules
m.getting-started.f4.desc: Set up the master data and explore modules such as Medical Records, Housing, Eggs, Diet and Animal Management.
m.getting-started.f5.title: Personalisation
m.getting-started.f5.desc: Manage notes, update your profile and adjust the language preferences.
m.getting-started.f6.title: Permissions
m.getting-started.f6.desc: Understand the access levels needed for secure operations.
